title: Excess success in "Don't count calorie labeling out: Calorie counts on the left side of menu items lead to lower calorie food choices"
engine: anomalyco/opencode (ReproAI) - DeepSeek V4 Flash via uniGPT
mode: live author-code re-run (R 4.6.1, post-corrigendum 'AC' scripts + pre-corrigendum variants) + independent reimplementation (R closed-form & Python 3.8 numpy/scipy Monte Carlo)
method: Test for Excess Success (TES): per-study power estimated by 100,000 Monte-Carlo replications of each Dallas et al. study (samples drawn from normal distributions with the reported means and a shared pooled SD, analysed with the same ANOVA + planned contrasts), and by closed-form two-sample-t power for studies 2 and S1; product of the six powers = overall success probability. Secondary: inverse-variance meta-analysis pooled Hedges' g and required-n power table.
